scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:back" "wait-on tcp:localhost:3001 && pnpm run dev:front"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n back,front,shared -c blue,green,pink "pnpm --filter @flex/back run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run lint"
scripts.check: concurrently -n back,front,shared -c blue,green,pink "pnpm --filter @flex/back run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run check"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flex/shared run build && concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @flex/back run build" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run build"
